description: This Java class 'DatabaseSpecificSQLGenerator' provides dialect-specific SQL query generation methods for different databases (MySQL and PostgreSQL). It includes functions for escaping identifiers, formatting values, constructing SQL clauses (like LIMIT, GROUP_CONCAT, date functions), and handling database-specific syntax differences. It also manages SQL query building for select, insert, update statements, and parameter binding for IN clauses.

classes.name: DatabaseSpecificSQLGenerator
classes.description: A utility class for generating database-specific SQL queries and fragments, supporting MySQL and PostgreSQL dialects.

methods.name: getDialect
methods.description: Returns the current database type/dialect.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes SQL identifiers based on the database type.

methods.name: formatValue
methods.description: Formats a value based on its JDBC type for SQL queries.

methods.name: groupConcat
methods.description: Generates a dialect-specific GROUP_CONCAT or STRING_AGG SQL expression.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Creates a LIMIT clause with optional offset.

methods.name: calcFoundRows
methods.description: Returns SQL for calculating total rows in MySQL.

methods.name: countLastExecutedQueryResult
methods.description: Returns SQL to get the number of rows from the last query.

methods.name: countQueryResult
methods.description: Wraps a SQL query to count its result rows, removing LIMIT/OFFSET.

methods.name: currentBusinessDate
methods.description: Returns SQL fragment for current business date.

methods.name: currentTenantDate
methods.description: Returns SQL fragment for current tenant date.

methods.name: currentTenantDateTime
methods.description: Returns SQL fragment for current tenant date and time.

methods.name: subDate
methods.description: Generates SQL for subtracting a time interval from a date.

methods.name: dateDiff
methods.description: Generates SQL for calculating date difference in days.

methods.name: castChar
methods.description: Casts a SQL expression to CHAR type.

methods.name: castInteger
methods.description: Casts a SQL expression to INTEGER type.

methods.name: currentSchema
methods.description: Returns SQL fragment for current schema.

methods.name: castJson
methods.description: Casts a SQL expression to JSON type.

methods.name: alias
methods.description: Creates an alias for a SQL field.

methods.name: buildSelect
methods.description: Builds a SELECT clause with specified fields and alias.

methods.name: buildFrom
methods.description: Builds a FROM clause with optional alias.

methods.name: buildJoin
methods.description: Builds a JOIN clause with specified parameters.

methods.name: buildOrderBy
methods.description: Builds an ORDER BY clause from a list of sort orders.

methods.name: buildInsert
methods.description: Builds an INSERT statement with placeholders.

methods.name: buildUpdate
methods.description: Builds an UPDATE statement with placeholders.

methods.name: decoratePlaceHolder
methods.description: Decorates placeholders, especially for JSON types in PostgreSQL.

methods.name: fetchPK
methods.description: Retrieves primary key value from GeneratedKeyHolder after insert.

methods.name: incrementDateByOneDay
methods.description: Generates SQL to increment a date by one day.

methods.name: in
methods.description: Creates a dialect-specific IN clause for a list of IDs.

methods.name: inParametersFor
methods.description: Provides parameter values for the IN clause, handling PostgreSQL array types.
